Name: Abigail Jastal
Badge: Everyday Sparks 2.0
Which strategy from this module (Daily Schedule, Take a Line for a Walk or Interpreting Visual Texts) feels most immediately usable in your teaching context? Why?:

The Interpreting visual texts of all the strategies feels like something that I could do right now in my classroom. One I did uses a simple image for the kids to evaluate one day and they really seemed to provide great questioning and feedback. Doing activities always really surprises me at how much curiosity middle schoolers have. This is a great way to introduce a new topic or even getting kids to push their questioning deeper.

What other strategies or approaches have you used to engage your students in routine writing over the course of this school year? What, if any, challenges have you encountered in engaging students in sustained routine writing?:
Something that we do pretty often in my class is timed writing. They kids really did not like it at the beginning of the year however they have grown a lot in their longevity. They are also growing in their ability to think farther about a topic because they are spending more amount of time writing about them.
